description: PostgreSQL before/after for softavg(value, score, eps) on IMDb: native SQL (naive / max-shift / clamp), pgvector HNSW top-k + AVG, vs bruce_pg 0.2.0 (internal state over softagg-core); state-representation A/B against the 0.1.2 float8[] path; sliding windows through the moving-aggregate form; pg_ivm / REFRESH maintenance; 0.1.2 -> 0.2.0 upgrade.

extension.name: bruce_pg
extension.build_cmd: cargo pgrx install --release --pg-config <server>/bin/pg_config (pgrx 0.18.1; profile.release opt-level=3, lto=fat, codegen-units=1)

protocol.timing: 1 warm-up + 3 timed runs, client wall (psycopg2 execute+fetchall), median; one extra EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF) per successful cell for plan shape / workers
protocol.reference: numpy float64 max-shifted per group, from the scores the server holds or computes
protocol.max_rel_err: max over groups of |pg - ref| / |ref|; NULL/NaN/Inf outputs counted separately
protocol.queries: queries.json (PROTOCOL sampler, 200 queries); this smoke run uses the first 3 (live score, top-k and precomputed columns s0..s2, all on the release server)

env.pg_version: PostgreSQL 17.10 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Ubuntu 11.4.0-1ubuntu1~22.04) 11.4.0, 64-bit
